description: This file defines a 'Loader' component using the LightningJS framework, which displays animated circles as a loading indicator with fade-in and fade-out transitions.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A LightningJS component that provides a loading indicator with animated circles.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts an interval that toggles the 'alpha' property between 0 and 1 to animate the fade-in and fade-out effect.
